transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand the operations team has proposed an automated warehouse project with a $10 million vendor quote, aimed at improving order throughput at our main distribution center. The vendor is offering either an outright equipment purchase or a five-year lease. As this is a significant capital allocation, I'd like to hear from accounting control and tax before I make my decision. Could we start with any issues from accounting control?

transcript.text: Elena, before you make your decision, I need to flag an important accounting issue I discovered this week while reviewing the vendor's invoice coding. $2,400,000 of the $10 million quote is actually implementation consulting and configuration support, not equipment. Under our capitalization policies, that portion must be charged to operating expense rather than capitalized. This means only $7,600,000 of the quote is eligible for capitalization. I have not yet posted this correction to the project file, so the numbers everyone has been working with need to be adjusted accordingly.
